mechanism: Build a short action proof around successive spatial gates: establish one carrier, one handled token and a fixed terminal goal; let each visible blocker force a different route change while preserving shared geography; convert the final opening into one decisive vertical terminal action; then hold a separate witness reaction without inventing an unshown numerical result.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable carrier, handled token and fixed terminal goal before escalation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without all three anchors, later movement reads as disconnected athletic montage.

invariants.rule: Use at least three visible spatial gates, each requiring a different route change.
invariants.purpose: Turns progression into spatial problem solving.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated identical dodges do not create escalating proof.

invariants.rule: Preserve the carrier, token and terminal direction across every route change.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing the token or goal axis breaks the causal route.

invariants.rule: Use the last route opening for one decisive vertical terminal action.
invariants.purpose: Converts horizontal escalation into a readable payoff transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple terminal attempts diffuse the climax.

invariants.rule: End on visible witness reaction and shared geography without asserting an unshown numerical result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A scoreboard or victory claim would exceed the visible proof.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

instantiations.concept: In an orbital greenhouse, one compact medical courier drone carries a luminous seed capsule through three moving wind-curtain gates. It changes height, lane and body angle, then uses the final updraft once to dock the capsule in an overhead sterile intake while two botanists visibly react.

instantiations.concept: In a stop-motion paper theatre, one clockwork courier carries a brass message bead through three independently moving scenery gates. It slips under a fan, circles a folding wall and climbs a paper ramp, then lifts the bead into a ceiling postbox as the ensemble holds a visible reaction.
